g.text: USB_DP/DM_PROT feed native STM32 USB by default. CP2102N debug path and USB links are DNP.

g.text: TPS259531DSGR eFuse creates VBUS_FUSED for the regulators; FLT_N is pulled to P3V3 for MCU fault telemetry.

g.text: USB-C sink input: TCPP01-M12 protects CC/VBUS. VBUS_CTRL divider is about 5.5 V nominal OVP for 5 V-only rails.
